# Composites West, Inc.

> Composites West is a carbon fiber and advanced composites "reinforcement boutique" founded in 2001, based in Reno, Nevada, USA. The company stocks 100,000 linear yards of composite reinforcement materials ready to ship, serving aerospace, marine, automotive, sporting goods, civil engineering/infrastructure, and industrial markets. Pricing is quote-based: call (775) 833-4300 or email info@compositeswest.com.

Key facts:
- Specialties: carbon fiber fabric reinforcements — woven (plain, twill, satin), non-crimp ±45° knits, unidirectional, and braid — plus fiberglass, prepregs, honeycomb core, vacuum bagging and infusion materials.
- Stocked fibers include high modulus (HR40), intermediate modulus, and 1K/3K/6K/12K standard modulus carbon.
- Brands stocked: Hexcel, Toray, FCIM, CFA.
- The Hex-3R product line is a complete FRP structural strengthening system for concrete repair and seismic retrofit: carbon/glass wraps, matched structural epoxies, FireLam fire-protection coatings, and FibrAnchor shear anchors.
